intent: Free functions for libstuff's microsecond-precision timestamp type: now(), format/parse to and from human timestamps, and calendar helpers.

objects.name: SComposeTime
objects.role: formats a microsecond timestamp via strftime

objects.name: STimestampToEpoch
objects.role: parses a formatted timestamp to epoch seconds

objects.name: STimestampMSToEpoch
objects.role: parses a formatted timestamp (with optional fractional seconds) to epoch milliseconds

objects.name: SToTimeval
objects.role: splits a microsecond timestamp into a timeval

objects.name: SFirstOfMonth
objects.role: first-of-month date, offset by a number of months

objects.name: STIMESTAMP_MS
objects.role: formats a microsecond timestamp with millisecond precision

misfits.why: declared in the libstuff.h catch-all rather than a dedicated STime.h, unlike other already-separated libstuff units

name_fit.note: name fits the content but the file has no header of its own

location_fit.note: declared in libstuff.h's catch-all rather than a dedicated header

naming_quality.note: STIMESTAMP_MS/SCURRENT_TIMESTAMP_MS use SCREAMING_CASE and read like macros, breaking from the PascalCase-after-S used by the rest of the file (STimeNow, SComposeTime)
